public.text: IHE is identified as the principal framework accommodated by the model. This may overemphasise IHE relative to FHIR implementation guides, SMART Guidelines, national profiles, OpenHIE workflows, DICOM conformance, and other domain standards.
public.suggestedRevision: Present IHE as a leading worked example rather than the principal universal framework. Explain how the model accommodates other profile and conformance ecosystems.
